description: Run your law firm in MyCase: open and update cases, add people, companies and leads, put tasks and events on the calendar, add notes, record time and expenses, read invoices and documents, and start workflows when a case, person, lead, event, invoice or task changes.

mycase_case_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a case is changed, such as its stage or status, with what it says now.

output.billing_contact: The person or company billed for the case (its id)
output.billing_type: How the case is billed: hourly, contingency, flat, mixed or pro_bono
output.case_number: The firm's own number for the case
output.case_stage: The stage the case is in
output.clients: The people (clients) on it, each with their id
output.closed_date: The day the case was closed, if it is
output.companies: The companies on it, each with their id
output.name: Its name
output.opened_date: The day the case was opened (YYYY-MM-DD)
output.outstanding_balance: What is still owed on the case
output.practice_area: The case's practice area, such as Family Law
output.staff: The staff on it, each with their id

mycase_invoice_paid_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice is paid in full.
